# Reconcile EWS request construction with the vendored type at that revision

1034 changes CreateItem.message_disposition from Option<MessageDisposition> to MessageDisposition and removes Some in the owned Rust client. The accepted newer sender again uses Some(MessageDisposition::SendOnly). Preserve each revision's paired field type and constructor instead of deriving a lasting style rule from removing Some. The vendor also adds extended-property XML types; those imported protocol structures are dependency context, not general Thunderbird field-naming authority. The already learned SendOnly/Sent-copy contract remains unchanged.

Scope: EWS vendored request type and owned constructor.
